checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: give the six wisp-kind enemies distinct silhouettes (echo orb+crystal, spirit ghost+antlers, shadow hooded, prism faceted gem, voidWalker tear, solderWisp ember) in _wisp, regenerating their sheets

impact_assessment.why: echo, spirit, shadow, prismEntity, voidWalker and solderWisp all share one wisp body with palette swaps, so the mid and late roster repeats one silhouette.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each wisp-kind enemy reads as a distinct creature at play scale without changing atlas keys or frame sizes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: _wisp signature and atlas keys unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: generated PNGs only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Regenerate all sheets, run the asset test, capture a live room with all six wisps, 8/8 gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement: _wisp now branches on shards/rift/antlers/hollow/slits/echo to draw distinct bodies (faceted gem, vertical tear, tall ghost, hooded cloak, ember core, orb+crystal); ribbon arms, tatters and accent dots retained; sheets regenerated
[3/3] Verify: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics, 8/8 gates; codebase map refreshed; live capture of all six wisps with zero console errors; checklists: passed
Task 'art-wisp-silhouettes-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: add a melee finisher - hits on enemies below 30% health deal +50% damage and restore 4 mana, rewarding aggressive cleanup.

impact_assessment.why: No reward for finishing wounded enemies; cleanup feels like a chore rather than a dopamine hit.
impact_assessment.benefits: Aggressive play is rewarded with bigger finishing hits and mana, increasing combo flow.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: damageEnemy signature unchanged, amount scaling internal; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: sim only, no save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test for finisher bonus and mana; existing tests still pass; gates.
